description: This file defines classes and types related to test suite and test case management in a testing framework, including Suite and TestCase classes, with methods for serialization, cloning, and test hierarchy navigation.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for test suite and test case, holding common properties like title.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, containing nested suites and test cases, with methods for managing hierarchy and serialization.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, with properties for execution results, metadata, and hierarchy navigation.

methods.name: titlePath
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical path of titles leading to the suite or test case.

methods.name: allTests
methods.description: Recursively collects all test cases within the suite.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the associated project, if available.

methods.name: outcome
methods.description: Determines the test case outcome based on results.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Returns true if the test outcome is expected or flaky.

methods.name: _serialize
methods.description: Serializes the suite or test case into a JSON-compatible object.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses serialized data to reconstruct suite or test case instances.

methods.name: _clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the suite or test case.

methods.name: _deepClone
methods.description: Deep clones the entire suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _deepSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the entire suite hierarchy.

methods.name: forEachTest
methods.description: Iterates over all test cases in the suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _addTest
methods.description: Adds a test case to the suite.

methods.name: _addSuite
methods.description: Adds a nested suite.

methods.name: _prependSuite
methods.description: Prepends a nested suite.

methods.name: _hasTests
methods.description: Checks if the suite contains any test cases.

methods.name: _collectGrepTitlePath
methods.description: Collects the title path and tags for grep filtering.

methods.name: _getOnlyItems
methods.description: Retrieves items marked as 'only' for focused testing.

methods.name: _appendTestResult
methods.description: Appends a new test result entry.

methods.name: _grepBaseTitlePath
methods.description: Builds the base title path for grep filtering.

methods.name: _grepTitleWithTags
methods.description: Returns the full title with tags for grep filtering.
